common.leave.title: Is journey se alag ho jaayein
common.leave.note: Alag hona aapka apna faisla hai. Kisi aur ka raazi hona zaroori nahi hai, aur kisi se poochha nahi jaata. Ye wapas nahi liya ja sakta: wapas aane ke liye, aapko ek naye invitation ki zaroorat hogi jis par yahan sab raazi hon.
common.leave.ownerFirst: Aap is journey ko ismein shamil sabke liye sambhalte hain, isliye aap is se abhi alag nahi ho sakte. Pehle Journey record ke andar yahan kisi aur ko owner banayein. Phir aap alag ho sakte hain.
common.leave.safety: Agar aapke alag hone ke baad koi aapse lagataar contact karta hai, to ledger-support@together-ledger.com par likhein. Together Ledger koi emergency service nahi hai; agar aap khatre mein hain, to apne local emergency number par call karein.
common.leave.start: Is journey se alag ho jaayein
common.leave.fieldHint: Ye aakhri kadam hai. Jab tak aap {word} type karke 'Is journey se abhi alag ho jaayein' ko press nahi karte, tab tak kuch nahi hota.
common.leave.confirm: Is journey se abhi alag ho jaayein
common.leave.consequence: Yahan aapke Private moments, aur wo moments jinhein aapne Baad mein share karne ke liye rakha tha, apni jagahein aur photos ke saath Delete ho jaate hain. Jo moments aapne share kiye the, wo baaki logon ke paas rehte hain, aur ab bhi dikhate hain ki unhein aapne sambhala tha. Aapka koi sujhaav ya bheja gaya invitation jo abhi bhi ruka hua hai, wo wapas le liya jaata hai. Journey ki History mein ye record hota hai ki aap alag ho gaye hain, aur kab. Kisi ko koi Email ya notification nahi bheji jaati. Agar aap is journey mein jagah ke liye web par pay karte hain, to wo payment pehle khatam hona chahiye. Jis jagah ke liye aap App Store ya Google Play mein pay karte hain, wo is journey ke saath rehti hai, aur alag hone se wo Cancel nahi hoti. Ise Apple ya Google ke saath Cancel karein, warna ye renew hoti rahegi.
common.leave.left: Aap “{journey}” se alag ho gaye hain. Ab ye aapki journeys mein nahi hai.

welcome.statement.eyebrow: Do logon ke liye banaya gaya
welcome.statement.title: Post karne ki ek aur jagah nahi. Yaad rakhne ki jagah.
welcome.statement.body: Aap tay karte hain ki ismein kya shamil hoga, iska naam kya hoga, aur ye kab share hone ke liye taiyaar hai. Ledger khaali shuru hota hai kyunki aapki story pehle se likhi hui nahi aani chahiye. Shuruaat mein ek journey mein do log hote hain, aur jab aap chahein to ismein aur saathiyon ke liye jagah banai ja sakti hai.
welcome.step.holdBody: Ek yaad, promise, feeling, boundary, practical detail, ya aapki apni tarah ka moment.
welcome.step.nameBody: Ek local visibility cue chunein aur aise shabdon ka istemaal karein jo dono logon ko sach lagein.
welcome.step.returnBody: Relationship ko score mein badle bina haal hi ke moments aur conversations par wapas lautein.

welcome.possibilities.title: Un aam cheezon ko sambhal kar rakhein jo zindagi ban jaati hain.

welcome.possibilities.promiseBody: Kuch aisa jise aap saath mein yaad rakhna chahte hain, bina kisi totals, rankings, ya feed ke.
welcome.possibilities.conversationBody: Ek khuli baat yahan aaraam kar sakti hai jab tak ki dono logon ke paas is par phir se lautne ki jagah na ho.

welcome.privacy.body: Together Ledger theek us waqt boundary banata hai jab ye zaroori hota hai. Browser-local space aur ek signed-in private journey alag-alag ghar hain.

welcome.privacy.syncBody: Private aur Baad mein share moments unhein banane wale ke paas hi rehte hain. Abhi share moments journey mein sabko dikhte hain, unke saath wo log bhi jo baad mein judenge.

welcome.closing.body: Bharne ke liye koi feed nahi. Improve karne ke liye koi relationship score nahi. Jab tak aap tay na karein tab tak kuch bhi joda nahi jaata.

moment.photo.unavailable: Photo load nahi ho payi. Phir se koshish karne ke liye select karein.
moment.form.localCopy: Visibility dhyaan se chunein. Browser-only mode mein, ye ek local cue hai, separate-account privacy nahi.

moment.form.photoHeld: Is moment mein pehle se iski image shamil hai. Ek aur image $1 har mahine ka add-on hai.

moment.form.photoMetadataRemoved: Upload hone se pehle, is device par iski location aur camera details hata di gayi hain.
moment.form.buyImage: Ek aur image jodein · $1 har mahine
moment.form.placesPrice: Pehli jagah shamil hai · har aur jagah $1 har mahine hai
moment.form.placesHelp: Sirf wahi jodein jo story batane mein madad kare. Aapke device ki location sirf tabhi request ki jaati hai jab aap ise chunte hain—background mein kabhi nahi.
moment.form.useLocation: Mere device ki location istemaal karein
moment.form.buyPlace: Ek aur jagah jodein · $1 har mahine
moment.form.noGeolocation: Ye browser device location share nahi kar sakta. Aap ab bhi ek jagah ka naam likh sakte hain.

moment.removePhoto.done: Is moment se photo Remove ho gayi.

journey.form.localCopy: Do log journey share karte hain. Ye jaankari is browser mein tab tak rehti hai jab tak aap ise export na karein.
journey.form.privateCopy: Ek naam ke saath shuruaat karein. Optional details tab tak ruk sakti hain jab tak wo theek na lagein.
journey.form.name: Journey ka naam
journey.form.placePlaceholder: Ise tabhi jodein agar ye aapko journey pehchanne mein madad kare
journey.form.unknownDate: Mujhe theek se yaad nahi hai

concern.form.subjectPlaceholder: Aisi kaun si baat hai jis par lautna achha lagega?

concern.form.synced: Conversation ke changes sync ho gaye.
concern.form.createdLocal: Conversation is browser mein log ho gayi.

signIn.dialog.boundary: Sign in karne par is browser mein pehle se rakha ledger kabhi upload, merge, ya Delete nahi hota. Hosted journeys ek alag account home ka istemaal karti hain.
signIn.toast.invitedEmail: Invite kiye gaye Email ke saath Sign in karein, phir invitation link ko dobara kholein.
sharing.copy.signedOut: Ek aur saathi ko invite karne ke liye Sign in karein aur ek private journey banayein.
sharing.copy.needsJourney: Aapka account taiyaar hai. Ek aur saathi ko invite karne ke liye ek private journey banayein.

sharing.copy.room: Ek aur saathi jodne ki jagah hai, aur yahan sabka unke liye raazi hona zaroori hai.
sharing.copy.noRoom: Abhi koi jagah khaali nahi hai.
sharing.copy.reservedOne: {person} ke liye 1 jagah reserved hai, unke invitation accept karne ka wait ho raha hai.

sharing.copy.separately: Har saathi alag se Sign in karta hai.
sharing.invite.email: Email se kisi saathi ka sujhaav dein
sharing.invite.emailNote: Kuch bhi bhejne se pehle is journey ke sabhi saathiyon ka raazi hona zaroori hai. Jab tak sab raazi nahi hote, is saathi tak kuch nahi pahunchta aur unhein is journey ke baare mein kuch pata nahi chalta.
sharing.invite.whoPlaceholder: Meri behen, jo aapke baare mein poochh rahi thi
sharing.invite.whoNote: Optional, aur ye faisla lene wale saathiyon ko dikhta hai, taaki wo ek address ke bajaye kisi insaan ke baare mein jawaab dein.
sharing.invite.sent: Invitation bhej diya gaya. Saathi ko apna khud ka verify kiya gaya account istemaal karna hoga.
sharing.invite.proposed: Sujhaav de diya gaya. Jab tak har saathi raazi nahi hota tab tak unhein kuch nahi bheja jaata.

sharing.record.deciding: Wo log jin par faisla ho raha hai
sharing.record.settled: Sujhaav jo pehle hi tay ho chuke hain

sharing.invitation.withdrawConsequence: Unka link kaam karna band kar deta hai, aur jo jagah isne roki thi wo turant phir se khaali ho jaati hai. Journey ki history mein ye record rehta hai ki ise wapas liya gaya tha.
sharing.invitation.withdrawn: Wapas le liya gaya. Link ab kaam nahi karta, aur jagah phir se khaali hai.
sharing.invitation.sentAgain: Phir se bhej diya gaya. Sab pehle se raazi the, isliye kisi se dobara nahi poochha gaya.

sharing.proposal.withdrawTitle: Kya {email} ko jodne ka sujhaav wapas lein?
sharing.proposal.withdrawConsequence: Sawaal wapas le liya jaata hai, aur unhein kuch nahi bheja jaata. Kisi ke naam par mana karna record nahi hota, aur is saathi ka baad mein phir se sujhaav diya ja sakta hai.
sharing.proposal.withdrawn: Wapas le liya gaya. Kuch nahi bheja gaya, aur kisi ko joda nahi gaya.
sharing.proposal.agreeTitle: Kya {email} ko jodne par raazi hain?
sharing.proposal.agreeConsequence: Jab har saathi raazi ho jayega aur wo judenge, to wo is journey mein share kiye gaye har moment ko padh sakenge, un moments ko bhi jo unke aane se bahut pehle share kiye gaye the. Jo moments aapne Private rakhe the, wo Private rehte hain.
sharing.proposal.declineTitle: Kya {email} ko jodne se mana karein?
sharing.proposal.declineConsequence: Ye sabke liye turant tay ho jaata hai, aur unhein kabhi kuch nahi bheja jaata. Faisle ke saath aapka naam aur waqt rakha jaata hai, jahan baaki saathi ise dekh sakte hain.
sharing.proposal.everyoneAgreed: Sab raazi hain. Invitation un tak pahunchne wala hai.
sharing.proposal.agreed: Aapka raazi hona record ho gaya hai. Jab tak sab jawaab nahi dete, tab tak kuch nahi bheja jaata.
sharing.proposal.declined: Record ho gaya. Kisi ko joda nahi gaya, aur unhein kuch nahi bheja gaya.
status.banner.storageFull: Ye browser us change ko save nahi kar saka. Ye abhi dikh raha hai, par agli baar jab ye page khulega tab shayad yahan na ho.
status.banner.offline: Aap offline hain. Ye journey abhi bhi yahan hai, aur kisi bhi aisi cheez ke liye jise account service chahiye, wo connection wapas aane tak rukegi.
error.server.internalError: Service request poori nahi kar saki.
error.server.invalidCsrf: Page ko refresh karein aur phir se koshish karein.
error.server.invalidOrigin: Ye request Together Ledger app se nahi aayi thi.
error.server.linkRequired: Aapka is Email ke saath pehle se ek account hai. Ise connect karne ke liye ek baar iska Password likhein.
error.server.invitationExists: Us saathi ke liye ek invitation pehle se hi wait kar raha hai.
error.server.alreadyMember: Wo saathi pehle se hi is journey mein hai.
error.server.proposalExists: Ye journey pehle hi us saathi ke baare mein tay kar rahi hai.
error.server.proposalClosed: Ye sujhaav pehle hi tay ho chuka hai.
error.server.proposalLapsed: Is sujhaav ka waqt khatam ho gaya, aur kisi ko joda nahi gaya.
error.server.alreadyDecided: Aap pehle hi is sujhaav ka jawaab de chuke hain.
error.server.consentIncomplete: Is journey mein abhi sab raazi nahi hue hain.
error.server.invalidInvitation: Ye invitation invalid hai, expire ho chuka hai, ya kisi aur Email address ka hai.
error.server.journeyOfOne: Aap is journey mein akele hain, isliye ise saunpne ke liye koi aur nahi hai.
